facets.answer: Research supports that customer samples have shipped and production shipments are guided to begin in the second half of 2026, with a later statement specifying a Q3 start. It does not establish that production shipments to customers have actually begun. Statements that the product is in production or that volume production has started are not confirmation of customer shipments.

Research shows prospective customer use and technical progress, not completed deployments at operating customer facilities. SK Telecom has a plan for a 2027 AI factory, and CoreWeave has reported bring-up and validation of an NVL72 system; neither establishes an operating facility with deployed Vera Rubin systems.

The around-$20-billion Vera sales figure is guidance, not reported or realized revenue; the research does not establish how much, if any, Vera revenue has been recognized. A nearly-$20-billion standalone CPU forecast is a separate measure and should not be treated as Vera revenue.
